name: Pokemon run
author: sapphire-omarchy-widget
description: Live view of a Pokemon agent run on any Gen 1-3 game: framebuffer, objective and progress, party HP, Pokedex and team analysis, location, opponent, session counters, and the agent's own narration.

barWidget.description: Lead Pokemon HP in the bar; the live screen, objective, party, dex and team progress, totals, and narration in the popup.

schema.label: Feed directory
schema.description: Directory pokeagent.live publishes into (paths.LIVE_DIR, by default <repo>/live). widget/install.sh pins this for you.

schema.label: Feed name
schema.description: The name passed to LiveFeed(name=...). One widget per name; allowMultiple is on so several runs can be watched side by side.

schema.label: Treat feed as dead after (seconds)
schema.description: The publisher writes state 4 times a second, so the default is roughly 24 missed writes.

schema.label: Show the game screen in the popup
Game
schema.description: Which registry entry to play. Only games whose artifacts are present will actually start; the rest report what is missing.

schema.label: ROM file
schema.description: Your own cartridge dump. Leave empty to use the ROM built from the bundled decompilation, which is what the tests use. Never committed.

schema.label: Trainer name
schema.description: Typed on the naming keyboard when a new game starts. Seven characters, the game's own limit.

schema.label: Starter
schema.description: Picked from Birch's bag. Gen 1/2 games use their own trio; this is read from the game registry.

schema.label: Nickname caught Pokemon
schema.description: Off keeps species names. On asks the local model for a name, falling back to the species when it is unreachable.

schema.label: Aggression / risk
schema.description: One slider for how brave the run is. 0 heals at 70% and only trains healthy Pokemon; 1 heals at 20% and walks into gyms at the leader's level.
